surface: active Teaching Pack /teaching-packs/* plus active content creator node

active_content_creator_behavior.malformed_json: content_creator_node catches json.JSONDecodeError/ValueError, logs failure, builds a retry prompt containing the failed output, and retries up to 3 attempts for only the requested artifact type
active_content_creator_behavior.timeout_or_provider_error: content_creator_node catches non-parse exceptions, logs failure, builds a retry prompt containing the previous output when available, and retries up to 3 attempts for only the requested artifact type
active_content_creator_behavior.exhausted_attempts: raises ValueError naming the failing artifact type, error class, and attempt count; TeachingPackExecutor persists run failure and TeachingPackWorker marks the job failed

older_artifact_workflow_behavior.malformed_json: services/gateway/artifact_workflow.py retries GenerationError('malformed_json', ...) for only the affected artifact and preserves passed artifacts
older_artifact_workflow_behavior.answer_key_healing: services/gateway/healing_executors.py can repair answer-key leakage before regeneration for deterministic quality failures
older_artifact_workflow_behavior.limitation: this orchestrator is not the active graph generation path for /teaching-packs/*

verification.py_compile: uv run python -m py_compile packages/agents/sub_agents/content_creator/nodes.py packages/agents/teaching_pack/nodes.py services/gateway/artifact_workflow.py services/gateway/healing_executors.py services/gateway/teaching_pack_executor.py services/gateway/teaching_pack_worker.py => success

unclosed_live_requirement.issue_011_requirement: Timeout/malformed JSON path that triggers adaptive streaming or typed healing
unclosed_live_requirement.reason: Current live 9Router/public-flow harness has no deterministic provider fault-injection control to force malformed JSON or a timeout from live 9Router without replacing live 9Router with a fake upstream. Existing live evidence proves successful 9Router flows and deterministic retry/fail-closed behavior, but not a live provider-induced malformed/timeout event.
unclosed_live_requirement.required_follow_up: Add a production-safe fault-injection test seam or a 9Router sandbox scenario that can deterministically emit one malformed JSON response or one timeout while preserving live HTTP/worker behavior, then rerun through /teaching-packs/* and capture run id/events/retry count.
